confidence_notes: Local food and drink guides provide useful but thin price bands. Cappuccino is estimated from nearby café prices; cocktail and wine anchors are estimated against local beer prices, with wine especially uncertain. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates and were not checked against listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use San Agustinillo and nearby Mazunte coastal price bands; no separate comparable city was used. Accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of small Oaxaca Pacific beach destinations.
